about.title: About
about.description: About this publication and how it helps readers.
about.body:
We publish practical updates and explainers about jobs, exams, results, scholarships and public schemes. Our goal is to help readers understand what changed, who it affects and what to check next.

## What we publish

- Job and recruitment updates
- Exam notices, dates and admit-card information
- Result announcements
- Scholarship opportunities
- Public scheme explainers

## Our approach

We aim to use clear language, link to official sources when available and keep important dates or eligibility details easy to find.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact the publication for corrections, questions or partnerships.
contact.body:
Use this page for editorial questions, correction requests, partnerships or general enquiries.

## Reporting an error

Please include the article URL and the detail you believe needs correction so it can be reviewed quickly.

editorialPolicy.title: Editorial Policy
editorialPolicy.description: How this publication researches, writes and updates content.
editorialPolicy.body:
Our editorial goal is to publish useful, understandable information based on reliable sources.

## Sourcing

We prefer official notices, government or institutional websites, primary documents and direct announcements when available.

## Writing and review

Articles should separate confirmed facts from interpretation, avoid misleading headlines and clearly present important dates, eligibility rules and official links.

## Updates

When information changes, articles may be revised and their updated date changed.

correctionsPolicy.title: Corrections Policy
correctionsPolicy.description: How this publication handles corrections, clarifications and updates.
correctionsPolicy.body:
We aim to keep published information accurate and current. When a material error is identified, we review the source information and correct the article as soon as practical.

## What we correct

We correct factual errors, outdated dates, broken eligibility details, inaccurate links and other information that could mislead a reader.

## Report an issue

Readers can use the Contact page to report a possible error. Please include the article URL and the detail that needs review.

advertisingPolicy.title: Advertising & Disclosure Policy
advertisingPolicy.description: How advertising, sponsorships and commercial relationships are handled.
advertisingPolicy.body:
Editorial content and advertising are kept separate. Advertising or sponsored material should not determine the conclusions of an editorial article.

## Advertising

The site may display third-party advertising. Ads should be visually distinguishable from editorial content.

## Sponsored or affiliate relationships

If the site uses affiliate links, paid placements or sponsored content, those relationships should be disclosed clearly near the relevant content.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy information for visitors to this website.
privacy.body:
This site may process standard technical information needed to deliver pages securely and reliably. If analytics, advertising or third-party services are enabled, they may process additional information according to their own policies.

## Analytics and advertising

The site settings may enable analytics or advertising services. When used, those services should be disclosed accurately and configured in line with applicable requirements.

## Contact

For privacy questions, use the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for using this website and its published information.
terms.body:
By using this website, you agree to use the information responsibly and to verify important application, eligibility, fee and deadline details with the official issuing authority.

## Informational purpose

Published content is intended to help readers understand public information and does not replace an official notification or authority website.

## Availability

We may update, correct or remove content when information changes.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Important information about the scope and limitations of this publication.
disclaimer.body:
Content is provided for general informational purposes. Job, exam, result, scholarship and scheme details can change, and official authorities remain the final source for eligibility, deadlines, fees, results and application requirements.

Always verify critical information using the official source before taking action.
